operations.title: Grothendieck publishes the quaternion-monodromy control as ledger 1275
operations.body: Ledger 1275 proves the product-exponent condition sufficient for arbitrary finite kernels: if gcd(n,exp K*exp M)=1, the total and quotient power maps are permutations, hence every fiber map is bijective. The first nonabelian monodromy control Q8 semidirect C3 has the exact converse: survivors are units modulo 12; even indices fail the identity fiber, odd multiples of 3 fail only nonidentity fibers. Coverage is 13,824 exact checks. The arbitrary-nonabelian converse remains explicitly open. No ring Adams, physical chain transfer, or build is claimed.
